Package org.apache.juneau.console

Class HandlerRef

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.HandlerRef
public final class HandlerRef extends Object
A reference to a client-side handler: a registered name or an opt-in inline body.

Names use the ns.name grammar and are registered on the page with JuneauViews.handlers.register. The juneau.* namespace is reserved for the built-ins (see builtin(String)).

Example:

HandlerRef a = HandlerRef.named("orders.refresh"); HandlerRef b = HandlerRef.builtin("refresh"); // juneau.refresh

Since:
10.0.0

      public static HandlerRef named(String name)
      A registered handler name.
      Parameters:
      name - The name, e.g. orders.refresh. A juneau.-prefixed name is accepted only when it names a built-in.
      Returns:
      A new reference.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the name is malformed or uses the reserved namespace.
